messages.task:
You are a financial analysis assistant.

Scenario (background):
American Airlines emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2013.  Within its Consolidated Statement of Operations the airline discloses a category called “reorganization items, net”, which aggregates several special items that arose directly from the Chapter 11 proceedings (e.g.
professional fees, labor-related deemed claims, valuation adjustments, etc.).  For the year 2013 each component has a dollar amount expressed in millions; the statement also reports a single line called “total reorganization items, net”.

Available tools:
• list_statement_types(year): list the statement types that exist for a given year.
• list_reorganization_components(year): list every component contained in the “reorganization items” statement for a given year.
• get_component_amount_millions(year, statement_type, component_keyword): fetch the dollar amount (in millions) for a component whose description contains the provided keyword (case-insensitive) within the chosen statement type and year.
• get_reorganization_total_millions(year): obtain the total (in millions) of the “reorganization items” statement for a given year.
• get_interest_expense_total_millions(year): return the total (in millions) of the “interest expense” statement for a given year.

Question you must answer:
What percentage of the 2013 “reorganization items, net” total was attributable to the labor-related deemed claim?

Instructions:
Think step-by-step, decide which tools you need, invoke them when helpful, and compute the percentage to one decimal place followed by the “%” sign (e.g. 12.3%).  Return only the final answer in that format.
